legal_entities.name: Wasteland Investment Management s. r. o.
Slovenský Energetický a Odpadový Fond s.r.o. (skrátený názov SEOF s.r.o.)

evidence.quote: The fund was set up as a fixed-term investment vehicle with an anticipated 10-year term, embarking on its operations in 2020 and closing its investment period in December 2023.
It prioritized investments in the waste management sector, without constraints regarding the company's age or operational scale.

analyst_notes: SEOF s.r.o. (IČO 52163920) is co-owned by National Development Fund II (SIH) and Wasteland; SIH describes the team as experienced in waste management and renewable energy projects. Infrastructure-project strategy (E3), no new investments after 2023 (E7).
